an8.19:1.1: 19 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā verañjāyaṃ viharati naḷerupūcimaṇḍe.
an8.19:1.2: athakho pahārādo asurindo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho pahārādaṃ asurindaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an8.19:2.1: api pana pahārāda asurā mahāsamudde abhiramantīti.
an8.19:2.3: kati pana pahārāda mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramantīti.
an8.19:2.4: aṭṭha bhante mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti
an8.19:2.6: mahāsamuddo bhante anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro nāyatakeneva papāto
an8.19:2.7: yampi bhante mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro nāyatakeneva papāto
an8.19:2.8: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde paṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhante mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velannātivattati
an8.19:3.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde dutiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhante mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvattati yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ taṃ khippameva tīraṃ vāheti thalaṃ ussādeti
an8.19:4.2: yampi bhante mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvattati yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ taṃ khippameva tīraṃ vāheti thalaṃ ussādeti
an8.19:4.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde tatiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhante yā kāci mahānadiyo seyyathīdaṃ
an8.19:5.2: gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni mahāsamuddotveva saṅkhayaṃ gacchanti
an8.19:5.3: yampi bhante yā kāci mahānadiyo seyyathīdaṃ gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni mahāsamuddotveva saṅkhayaṃ gacchanti
an8.19:5.4: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde catuttho acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhante yā kāci loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti na tena mahāsamuddassa unnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati
an8.19:6.2: yampi bhante yā kāci loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti na tena mahāsamuddassa unnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati
an8.19:6.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde pañcamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhante mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso
an8.19:7.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhante mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano tatrimāni ratanāni seyyathīdaṃ muttā maṇi veḍuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅgo masāragallaṃ
an8.19:8.2: yampi bhante mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano tatrimāni ratanāni seyyathīdaṃ muttā maṇi veḍuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅgo masāragallaṃ
an8.19:8.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde sattamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:9.1: puna caparaṃ bhante mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā dviyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā tiyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā catuyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā
an8.19:9.2: yampi bhante mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrīme bhūtā timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā …pe… tiyojanasatikāpi catuyojanasatikāpi pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā
an8.19:9.3: ayaṃ bhante mahāsamudde aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:9.4: ime kho bhante mahāsamudde aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.19:10.1: api pana bhante bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantīti.
an8.19:10.3: kati pana bhante imasmiṃ dhammavinaye acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantīti.
an8.19:10.4: aṭṭha pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti
an8.19:10.6: seyyathāpi pahārāda mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro nāyatakeneva papāto
an8.19:10.7: evameva kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā nāyatakeneva aññāpaṭivedho
an8.19:10.8: yampi pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā nāyatakeneva aññāpaṭivedho
an8.19:10.9: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye paṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:11.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati
an8.19:11.2: evameva kho pahārāda yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetupi nātikkamanti
an8.19:11.3: yampi pahārāda mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetupi nātikkamanti
an8.19:11.4: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye dutiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:12.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvattati yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ taṃ khippameva tīraṃ vāheti thalaṃ ussādeti
an8.19:13.1: evameva kho pahārāda yo so puggalo dussīlo pāpadhammo asucisaṃkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambukajāto na tena saṅgho saṃvasati khippameva naṃ sannipatitvā ukkhipati kiñcāpi so hoti majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinno athakho so ārakāva saṅghamhā saṅgho ca tena
an8.19:13.2: yampi pahārāda yo puggalo dussīlo pāpadhammo asucisaṃkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambukajāto na tena saṅgho saṃvasati khippaṃyeva naṃ sannipatitvā ukkhipati kiñcāpi so hoti majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinno athakho so ārakāva saṅghamhā saṅgho ca tena
an8.19:13.3: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye tatiyo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:14.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda yā kāci mahānadiyo seyyathīdaṃ gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni mahāsamuddotveva saṅkhayaṃ gacchanti
an8.19:14.2: evameva kho pahārāda cattārome vaṇṇā khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā te tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni samaṇo sakyaputtiyotveva saṅkhayaṃ gacchanti
an8.19:14.3: yampi pahārāda cattārome vaṇṇā khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā te tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni samaṇo sakyaputtiyotveva saṅkhayaṃ gacchanti
an8.19:14.4: ayampi pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye catuttho acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:15.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda yā kāci loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti yā ca antalikkhā dhārā papatanti na tena mahāsamuddassa unnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati
an8.19:15.2: evameva kho pahārāda bahū cepi bhikkhū anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti na tena nibbānadhātuyā unnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati
an8.19:15.3: yampi pahārāda bahū cepi bhikkhū anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti na tena nibbānadhātuyā unnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati
an8.19:15.4: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pañcamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:16.2: evameva kho pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso
an8.19:16.3: yampi pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso
an8.19:16.4: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:17.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano tatrimāni ratanāni seyyathīdaṃ muttā maṇi veḍuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohitaṅgo masāragallaṃ
an8.19:17.2: evameva kho pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano tatrimāni ratanāni seyyathīdaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañcindriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo
an8.19:17.3: yampi pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano tatrimāni ratanāni seyyathīdaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañcindriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo
an8.19:17.4: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye sattamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:18.1: seyyathāpi pahārāda mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā dviyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā tiyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā catuyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā
an8.19:18.2: evameva kho pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno arahā arahattāya paṭipanno
an8.19:18.3: yampi pahārāda ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso tatrime bhūtā sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno arahā arahattāya paṭipanno
an8.19:18.4: ayaṃ pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.19:19.1: ime kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantīti.
